summary_text: ARM stock traded at $223.15, up 3.73% as bullish momentum persists. ARM is up 102% YTD, doubling in under five months. Bernstein initiated coverage at Outperform with $300 price target. ARM's annualized contract value grew 22% YoY. Demand for ARM AGI CPUs is above $2 billion for fiscal 2027-2028, but supply chain initially sized for $1 billion, with constraints in wafers, memory, packaging and test capacity. ARM facing FTC antitrust probe into licensing practices.
